name: grammar-tracker
description: Checks the English grammar of each prompt, counts repeated mistakes, and shows the check in a band and a pane

autoOpenPane.title: Open the pane on a check
autoOpenPane.description: Open the Grammar pane by itself when a check with mistakes arrives

showTypeRules.title: Show the type's rule on every card
showTypeRules.description: Show what each type of mistake is, with an example, on every mistake card. The r key in the pane shows or hides them all, and each card's button its own

native_language.title: Native language
native_language.description: The language you speak natively. The grammar check looks for the mistakes its speakers make in English.
